formal_role: The integral accumulates a specified rate density intensity or marginal quantity
review_warning: If the integrand is misdefined the total-change estimate is invalid

formal_role: The lower and upper limits define the accumulation period or domain
systems_modeling_role: Keeps cumulative claims tied to a specific interval
review_warning: Changing bounds changes the result and may change the conclusion

formal_role: A definite integral is signed unless the absolute value is integrated
systems_modeling_role: Distinguishes net change from total activity
review_warning: Signed cancellation can hide large offsetting movement

formal_role: Rate units times integration-variable units should produce accumulated quantity units
review_warning: Unit mismatch can invalidate the integral interpretation

formal_role: Approximate integrals depend on grid method and interpolation
review_warning: Coarse grids missing data or noise can distort total change
